question: Menene ma'anar karin magana a harshen Hausa?

question: A ina ne asalin mafi yawan karin maganar Hausa ya fito?
explanation: Asalin karin magana yana fitowa ne daga abubuwan da suka shafi rayuwar mutane da mu'amalarsu.
subtopic: Ma'ana da Asalin Karin Magana

question: Wane abu ne ke ba da jigo ga mafi yawan karin magana?
explanation: Malaman harshe sun lura cewa dabbobi da dama suna zama jigo a karin maganar Hausa saboda kusancinsu da mutane.
subtopic: Ma'ana da Asalin Karin Magana

question: Wane ne ke da ikon kirkirar karin magana a al'adance?

question: Menene babban amfanin amfani da karin magana a jawabi?
explanation: Ana amfani da karin magana ne domin yi wa magana ado da kuma isar da sako cikin kankanin lokaci.
subtopic: Ma'ana da Asalin Karin Magana

question: Ta wace kafa ake gadon karin magana galibi?
explanation: Tunda asali al'ada ce ta gargajiya, ana gadon karin magana ne ta hanyar baka zuwa baka.

question: Me ake nufi da maganganun azanci a Hausa?
explanation: Maganganun azanci sune maganganu da ke bukatan basira da fahimta sosai kafin a gane manufarsu.

question: Ta yaya tarihi ke shafar asalin karin magana?

options.B: Yana adana abubuwan da suka faru a baya

question: Wane bangare na al'adun Hausa karin magana yake wakilta?
explanation: Karin magana na karkashin adabin baka ne kuma yana kunshe da hikimomin magabata.

question: Mene ne bambanci tsakanin karin magana da tatsuniya?

question: Wane ne bambanci tsakanin karin magana da karin harshe?
explanation: Karin harshe yana nuna yanki ko asalin mai magana, yayin da karin magana gajeren zance ne na hikima.

question: Wane ne sifa ta musamman ga karin magana?
explanation: Karin magana kan zo da ma'ana ta boye wadda ake bukatan basira don fahimtarta.

question: Ta yaya karin harshe yake shafar lafazi?
explanation: Karin harshe na canza yadda ake furta wasu kalmomi dangane da yankin da ake ciki.

question: Shin karin magana na canzawa bisa ga mutum?

options.A: Eh, kowane mutum na da nasa

explanation: Karin magana gadon al'umma ne kuma ba na mutum daya ba ne kawai.

question: Mene ne babban amfanin karin harshe a zamantakewa?
explanation: Ta hanyar karin harshe, ana iya gane yankin da mutum ya fito.

question: Wanne daga cikin wadannan ke nuna karin magana ba karin harshe ba?

options.C: Gidan da aka gina da yumbu

question: Ta yaya ake rarrabe karin harshe da daidaitacciyar Hausa?

options.B: Ta wajen bambancin sauti da kalmomi

explanation: Karin harshe na da nashi sautin da kalmomin da suka bambanta da ta daidaitacciyar Hausa.

question: Wanne ne cikakken bayani game da rarrabe su?
explanation: Karin harshe yana karkashin rarrabuwar yare, yayin da karin magana ke karkashin azanci.

question: Wane rukuni karin magana yake ciki?
explanation: Karin magana na daya daga cikin abubuwan da ke karkashin adabin gargajiya.

question: Me ke nuna cewa ana amfani da karin harshe ne?
explanation: Sautin da mutum yake fitarwa wanda ke nuna garinsa shi ne ke bayyana karin harshe.

question: Wane ne amfanin karin magana a al'adun Hausawa?
explanation: Karin magana na ƙara wa zance armashi da bayyana zurfin hikimar Hausawa.

question: Menene ma'anar karin maganar nan: "Dan kowa ruwa ne gudu"?
explanation: Wannan karin magana na nuna cewa mutuwa ko kaddara ta shafi kowa ne ba ta da sarauta.

question: A wane lokaci ake fi amfani da karin magana a wajen Hausawa?
explanation: Ana amfani da karin magana domin zuzzurfa ma'ana a cikin jawabi ko huduba.

question: Mene ne manufar sanya karin magana yayin gargaɗi?

options.B: Sauƙaƙe fahimtar saƙo ba tare da zagi ba

question: Wanne daga cikin wadannan ne ke nuna muhimmancin karin magana ga yara?

options.C: Koya musu tarbiya da kuma sarrafa harshe

explanation: Karin magana na taimaka wa yara su fahimci al'ada da kuma kyawawan dabi'u.

question: Menene ma'anar karin magana: "Ba a san macci amana ba sai a ruwa"?
explanation: Wannan karin magana na nuna cewa a lokacin tsanani ne gaskiyar mutum take bayyana.

question: Ta yaya karin magana ke taimakawa wajen tattalin arziki?

options.A: Ba ta da alaka da arziki
options.B: Wajen kwadaitar da sana'a da aikin kwarai

explanation: Akwai karin maganganun da ke jaddada amfanin aiki da kuma kauce wa rago.

question: Wane ne ake tsammanin ya fi sanin karin magana a al'adun gargajiya?

options.B: Dattawa da masu ji da al'ada
options.C: Mutumin da ya zo daga waje

question: Menene fassarar amfani da karin magana a matsayin 'gishirin zance'?

options.A: Yana sa zance ya yi zafi
options.B: Yana sa zance ya zama mai dadi da armashi
options.D: Yana sa mutum ya ƙi magana

question: Wanne daga cikin wadannan ba gaskiya bane game da karin magana?

question: Wane ne ma'anar boye na karin magana: 'Dan kuka da baki'?

question: Menene ainihin ma'anar 'Karin magana: 'Kura da fatar tumaki'?
explanation: Kura da fatar tumaki tana wakiltar mutumin da ke boye mugun nufinsa a karkashin kyakkyawan kamanni.

question: Wane bayani ne ya dace da azancin: 'Ruwan dare'?
explanation: Ruwan dare azanci ne da ke nufin abu ko lamarin da ya shafi kowa ko ya zama gama gari.
subtopic: Fassara da Bayanin Ma'anar Boye na Maganganun Azanci

question: Mene ne ma'anar boye ta maganar azanci: 'Gani ga wane'?
explanation: Gani ga wane yana nufin daukar darasi ko gargaɗi daga abin da ya faru ga wani mutum.

question: Mene ne ake nufi da 'Cin kafar mutum' a maganar azanci?
explanation: Cin kafar mutum yana nufin zama sanadin faduwarsa ko samun wata babban asara a rayuwa.

question: Wace ma'ana ce ke boye a cikin 'Bakin ciki'?
explanation: A azancin Hausa, bakin ciki ba kawai bacin rai ba ne, yana nufin hassada ko mugun nufi ga wani.
subtopic: Fassara da Bayanin Ma'anar Boye na Maganganun Azanci

question: Menene ma'anar azanci ta 'Daure gindi'?
explanation: Daure gindi yana nufin bayar da goyon baya ko taimako domin cimma wata manufa.
subtopic: Fassara da Bayanin Ma'anar Boye na Maganganun Azanci

question: Mene ne ake nufi da 'Hawan kashi' a maganar azanci?
explanation: Hawan kashi na nufin shiga cikin wani yanayi na hatsari ko tsoro wanda ba shi da tabbas.

question: Mene ne ma'anar boye ta 'Tsibirin magana'?

options.D: Magana ba tare da tunani ba

explanation: Tsibirin magana na nufin kalamai ko bayani mai zurfin gaske wanda sai an nutsu ake gane shi.

question: Wane bayani ne ke nuna ma'anar 'Jan kafa'?
explanation: Jan kafa yana nufin nuna ragwanci ko jinkirin yin wani abu da gangan.
subtopic: Fassara da Bayanin Ma'anar Boye na Maganganun Azanci
